sources.title: Koopman Lyapunov‐based model predictive control of nonlinear chemical process systems
sources.inspected: Publisher abstract and public 12-page journal article; Introduction, Sections 2-3, and CSTR application introduction.
sources.supported_claim: EDMD-based linear Koopman prediction combined with Lyapunov-based MPC; chemical reactor stabilization under the stated controller assumptions.
sources.relation: Chemical-process predictive-control background and a controller-design precedent.
sources.boundary: No quantitative superiority comparison or stability guarantee transferred to DLM-K.

sources.title: Identification of noisy Koopman models
sources.inspected: Publisher-indexed abstract/highlights, author-posted SSRN abstract, Crossref publisher-deposited exact PII/DOI mapping, and author publication list. Full journal body was not available through these tools.
sources.supported_claim: EDMD-like noisy identification; likelihood characterization of noise; block-coordinate regularized joint identification of model and noise components; distillation-column case.
sources.relation: Noise-aware model identification rather than a frozen-checkpoint sensor-perturbation audit.
sources.boundary: Cited at abstract-supported scope only; no theorem details, exact noise assumptions, delayed-system guarantee, or numerical performance comparison asserted.
sources.year_resolution: DOI/PII use 2025 and online appearance was in 2025; assigned journal issue is January 2026, volume 204. Use 2026 consistently with the completed journal citation.

sources.title: Data-driven feedback stabilisation of nonlinear systems: Koopman-based model predictive control
sources.inspected: Published publisher abstract and Crossref final issue metadata; related arXiv v2 inspected for the bilinear/CLF design context, not used as final journal bibliographic metadata.
sources.supported_claim: Koopman eigenfunction coordinates and bilinear controlled dynamics; predictive control using a CLF-based bounded auxiliary controller.
sources.relation: Data-driven stabilization design background, distinct from an additive-input nonlinear-memory predictor.
sources.boundary: The two-author 2020 preprint differs from the final three-author paper. No preprint-only inverse-map theorem is attributed to the final article.
sources.year_resolution: Accepted-author version in December 2021, online publication January 2022, assigned issue March 2023. Use 2023 for volume 96(3), pp.770-781.
